pay.summary: Nothing on this board is paid yet. Proposed: each job paid per measured job, monthly in arrears, budgeted in pounds and settled in KAB inside a monthly cap that holders vote. Collators first.

needs.note: at least three collators, run by different people on different machines
Birdbrain's endpoint plus at least two independent ones

jobs.title: Run a plain node for 14 days
jobs.summary: Follow the chain on your own machine. No key, no vote, nothing at risk. Two weeks of a node that stays up starts your record.
jobs.machine: 4 vCPU, 8 GB RAM, 100 GB SSD, public IPv4, TCP 30333 and 30334 open
jobs.test: p2p port answers, checked every ten minutes from Birdbrain's box. Synced-to-head check from our peers is being set up.

jobs.title: Run a public RPC endpoint
jobs.summary: Give wallets, explorers and the holders' page somewhere to read Kabocha that is not Birdbrain.
jobs.machine: a plain node plus a domain, TLS and a reverse proxy; safe RPC methods only
jobs.test: head and genesis hash read from the endpoint every ten minutes; passes within ten blocks of our head
jobs.pass: share of checks passed over 30 days

pay.joins_budget: after a quarter of clean collator payouts

jobs.title: Hold a collator seat
jobs.summary: Make Kabocha's blocks. The seat is added by a holders' referendum, with your record attached.
jobs.machine: the rung 1 node, on its own machine
jobs.test: blocks authored by your account each session, read on chain, against the slots it was due
jobs.pass: share of due slots authored over 30 days

pay.basis: hardware range from real prices, labour an assumption until operators confirm
pay.joins_budget: first, once holders vote a budget

jobs.title: Run an archive node
jobs.summary: Keep every past state of the chain so anyone can check history back to 2022.
jobs.machine: a plain node in archive mode, growing disk, a public RPC in front
jobs.test: an account's balance at a random old block, compared with our own reading, every hour (not running yet)

pay.joins_budget: after a quarter of clean collator payouts

operators.note: Kabocha's only collator today. Not paid from an operator budget, or its payment is declared.
